linkInstrument.fadeMarginTip: Fade margin: signal above the noise floor. Above 25 dB is comfortable, under 12 dB the link is close to dropping.
linkInstrument.fecTip: Damaged packets repaired by forward error correction; rising counts mean the link is working hard
linkInstrument.groundReceiveTip: What the ground-side modem hears from the vehicle
linkInstrument.noModem: No telemetry modem is reporting on this link. RADIO_STATUS comes from SiK/RFD900-class radios and wfb-ng or ELRS gateways; direct USB and plain network links do not send it.
linkInstrument.noiseTip: Background noise floor (raw and SiK-calibrated dBm)
linkInstrument.rcRssiTip: Separate RC receiver signal reported by the flight controller
linkInstrument.rssiTip: Received signal strength (raw and SiK-calibrated dBm; other modems scale differently)
linkInstrument.rxErrorsTip: Packets lost to reception errors since boot (cumulative, with current rate)
linkInstrument.title: Link
linkInstrument.txBufferTip: Free space in the radio's transmit buffer; near 0% the link cannot keep up with outgoing data
linkInstrument.vehicleReceiveTip: What the vehicle-side modem hears from the ground (reported back over the link)

mapCommand.aslAboveHome: {{alt}} m above sea level = {{above}} m above home here.
mapCommand.aslBelowHome: {{alt}} m above sea level is AT or BELOW home ground level here (home is {{home}} m AMSL).
mapCommand.belowAirspeedMin: Below AIRSPEED_MIN ({{min}} {{unit}}); the vehicle will refuse this speed
mapCommand.climbRtlHint: Climb in place to a safe altitude, then return home.
mapCommand.flyHint: Guided move to this point at the set altitude.
mapCommand.frameHomeTip: Above the home / launch point (ArduPilot default)
mapCommand.frameTerrainTip: Above the ground below the vehicle. Needs terrain data or a rangefinder.
mapCommand.landHint: Fly to this point, then descend and land.
mapCommand.lookHint: Gimbal locks on and tracks this point as the vehicle moves. Flight path unchanged.
mapCommand.noTerrain: {{label}} has no terrain data: it will reject this command.
mapCommand.orbitHint: Circle this point at fixed altitude.
mapCommand.orbitScriptMissing: Script not installed: native DO_ORBIT, orbit count ignored.
mapCommand.orbitScriptStale: Script silent: native DO_ORBIT fallback, orbit count ignored.
mapCommand.revealHint: Pull back and climb with the camera locked on this target.
mapCommand.scriptMissing: Needs the ArduDeck Lua script on the flight controller.
mapCommand.scriptStale: ArduDeck Lua script installed but not responding.
mapCommand.spiralHint: Orbit while climbing or descending to a target altitude.
mapCommand.strafeHint: Dolly past the target at a perpendicular offset, camera locked on.
mapCommand.targetTip: Vehicle this command will be sent to
mapCommand.terrainOnBoard: Vehicle reports terrain data on board.
mapCommand.vtolArrivalCircle: On arrival it circles as a plane; it will not hover (Q_GUIDED_MODE is off).
mapCommand.vtolArrivalHover: On arrival it transitions back and hovers there.
mapCommand.vtolArrivalUnknown: On arrival it depends on Q_GUIDED_MODE, which has not been read yet.
mapCommand.vtolHint: Transitions to forward flight and flies there on the wing, not in hover. {{arrival}}
mapCommand.watchHint: Hover at this point and rotate slowly for a panoramic view.
mapCommand.wingmanWarning: {{label}} is a wingman. The formation loop re-targets it every tick, so this command will be accepted and immediately overridden. Command the leader, or drop it from the fleet first.
mapCommand.wingmanWarningOf: {{label}} is a wingman of SYS {{leader}}. The formation loop re-targets it every tick, so this command will be accepted and immediately overridden. Command the leader, or drop it from the fleet first.
